correctness.rationale: Disproof is mathematically correct. Cofiber S^{0,-1} --tau--> S --c--> Ctau --d--> S^{1,-1} gives [S^{s,w},S^{1,-1}]=pi_{s-1,w+1}, so d_*: pi_{70,w}(Ctau)->pi_{69,w+1}(S_mot) for every w. Betti Re sends S^{p,q}|->S^p, so Re_*: pi_{s,w}->pi_s; composite lands in pi_69^{cl}, never pi_70^{cl}. Hence equality Re(d_*(p))=2.x in pi_70 is ill-typed across distinct groups (claim (a)). Vanishing (b) follows from standard Re(tau)=1, so Re(Ctau)~* and naturality Re o d^{mot}=d^{cl} o Re gives Re(d(p))=d^{cl}(0)=0. Replayed inputs/artifacts/verify.py -> VERIFY_OK confirming 70->69 for all w in [-10,30) and that only s=71 lands in 70. Sections 2-4 are proofs from cofiber + Re; Sec.5 is honestly labeled computed degree certificate; Sec.6 honestly limits scope (no claim about pi_70 hidden extensions by other routes, stem-71 repair, or Ctau product). No boundary error, no weight dependence error, no chart dependence.

originality.rationale: Literal string 'stem-70 Ctau-boundary transfer impossible' appears in no prior title, but originality FAILS under adversarial implication test: the headline is an immediate 2-step corollary of published stronger general facts that substantively imply it. Gheorghe (2017, arXiv:1701.04877 / Documenta 2018) proves tau: S^{0,-1}->S, Ctau E_infty structure, pi_{**}Ctau = Ext_{BP_*BP}, and that Ctau-Mod lives in kernel of Betti realization (i.e. Re(Ctau)~* because Re(tau)=1). Standard motivic LES degree [S^{s,w},S^{1,-1}]=pi_{s-1,w+1} (Isaksen Stable Stems, Belmont-Guillou-Isaksen, Wang motctau notes) gives the stem-drop for all (s,w). Instantiating at s=70 yields (a) and (b) with no new mathematics, chart, or computation beyond 69!=70. Fused search (20 results, full provider coverage, no partial failure) returned only these general inputs plus unrelated tau-lepton decays; no source records the stem-70 instantiation, but verbatim absence does not establish priority when a broader theorem exhaustively covers the claim as a special case. This is recomputation/certificate/repackaging of a known stronger fact.

value.rationale: Correct but intrinsically low retrieval value. The headline establishes only an elementary type error in the admitted proposal: 69!=70 and 0!=nonzero. It decides no 2-primary group structure, pins no hidden extension, validates no Ctau product, and proves no stem-71 repair (explicitly left as conjecture/direction). A future researcher needing this fact needs the general LES degree formula and Re(Ctau)~*, both already retrievable textbook/comparison theorems — not the s=70 instance. Per value policy, textbook restatements, mere parameter substitutions (here s=70 plugged into general shift), and certifications of arbitrary instances are rejected even if correct and new. Certification via stdlib degree arithmetic does not rescue an instance whose content is 69!=70. No downstream surgery/cobordism/chromatic use is enabled beyond avoiding one ill-typed route.
